preamble: Chapter rule 1: Fish, crustaceans, molluscs and other aquatic invertebrates of this chapter shall be deemed originating even if they were cultivated from nonoriginating fry (immature fish at a post-larval stage, including fingerlings, parr, smolts and elvers) or larvae.

rules.text: A change to headings 0301 through 0307 from any other chapter.
